bias.en: Turning bullish · rejected again at the $388 cap
bias.zh: 转多 · 再度受阻于 $388 上限

read.en: Tesla fell 3.1% on Oct 22 to $374.58, trading between $373.71 and $388.86 on 1.5 times average volume. It is above the falling 5-day ($371.5), falling 10-day ($372.3), rising 30-day ($369.3) and falling 100-day ($368.8) averages, and below the falling 200-day ($386.6). MACD is above its signal (since Oct 21) and zero, but only just; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Oct 21 ($350.12), and RSI is 53.
read.zh: 特斯拉 10月22日下跌 3.1%，收于 $374.58，盘中区间 $373.71–388.86，成交量为平均水平的 1.5 倍。股价位于下行的 5 日（$371.5）、下行的 10 日（$372.3）、上行的 30 日（$369.3）和下行的 100 日均线（$368.8）上方，低于下行的 200 日均线（$386.6）。MACD 位于信号线（自 10月21日起）及零轴上方，但优势很小；抛物线 SAR 自 10月21日起看多（$350.12），RSI 为 53。

read.en: The high tagged the $388 cap and was rejected again; the close fell back below $377.6 (Oct 20 high, Oct 12 low), resistance again. Resistance is $377.6, then $386.6–388.9 (200-day, $388 cap) and $409 (Apr 17 high). Support is $368.8–372.3, then $363.6 (Oct 20 low) and $349.3–350.1 (SAR, Oct 16 low). A close above $388.9 would target $409–418; a close below $368.8 would open $350.

r.en: Oct 20 high; Oct 12 low, resistance again
r.zh: 10月20日高点；10月12日低点，再度转为阻力

r.en: $388 cap since March plus the 200-day average ($386.6); Oct 22 high $388.86
